title: I-35 Denton construction
text: In April 2024 TxDOT awarded a $611 million contract to Sema Construction for reconstruction and expansion of I-35 in Denton, including the interchange where I-35 splits into I-35E and I-35W. A separate contract was awarded to Zachry Construction in June 2025 to expand the freeway at Mayhill Road.
